scenario: LCST.4.5.5 — String->Bool is fallible: it parses exactly the NFC strings "true"/"false" (case-sensitive) to Bool and yields null on anything else, so it requires '::Bool?' and feeds the LNUL stack. Pin: s.txt::Bool? == true in a where predicate compiles.
rules_ds:
schema P scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    txt: String mutable

rule r:
    P p where p.txt::Bool? == true
->
    log info "ok"
